messages:
dmitri: FYI seeing a sustained ~30% throughput drop on dp-redwood-12 since ~09:12 UTC. Customer A and B report elevated latencies and occasional 5xx. Queue depth spike on scheduler metrics.
megan: ugh. Is this the same pool we tuned last week? any noisy tenant flagged? :eyes:
alejandro: holding — checking tenant QPS/avg tokens now. initial glance shows lots of small requests (avg tokens 18) from a new integration. That can kill pack utilization.
support-jenny: Customer A opened a ticket, pasted this snippet: `status: 503, retry-after: 60`, but spikes are intermittent. They said it started after their SDK upgrade this morning.
dmitri: logs show continuous-batcher fill-rate dropped: 
```
batcher.fill_rate: 0.42 -> 0.25
pack_utilization: 0.72 -> 0.45
max_batch_tokens: 20480
requests_per_sec: 1200 -> 900
```
megan: pack_utilization down to 0.45 is huge. If traffic is predominantly tiny requests, the batcher will produce many tiny micro-batches, raising per-token overhead and queuing.
alejandro: confirming — top 5 tenants by request count include that new integration (tenant: sdk-integ-47) with 70% small calls and aggressive concurrency. Could be noisy neighbor.
sre-oncall: autoscaler logs? Did a scale event coincide?
infra-bot: [deploy-bot] scale_event: pool=dp-redwood-12, action=scale_up, from=6->8, triggered_by=cpu_threshold, ts=4087654300
megan: autoscaler did a scale_up at 09:18 but queue didn't drain. That often means packing inefficiency rather than raw capacity.
dmitri: repro steps I'm doing: 1) replay synthetic traffic with same token distribution (70% <= 20 tokens, 30% long). 2) run with old scheduler config (pack_window_ms=12, max_batch_tokens=20480) vs tuned (pack_window_ms=40).
dmitri: quick test results locally: pack_window_ms=12 -> avg batch size 2.1, throughput 850rps. pack_window_ms=40 -> avg batch size 5.6, throughput 1100rps. Latency P95 increased slightly for single short requests but overall good for customer SLA.
support-jenny: customers prefer steady throughput >900rps. They can tolerate slight p95 increase for tiny requests.
alejandro: we might push a temporary scheduler tweak: increase pack_window_ms to 40 and raise pack_max_wait_tokens to favor combining small requests. Also consider per-tenant QoS to cap concurrency for sdk-integ-47.
sre-oncall: any auth/billing issues? could retries be causing duplicate tiny requests?
support-jenny: no billing errors reported. SDK change may have added aggressive retry policy on 429/5xx.
dmitri: I dug into request traces: multiple 429->retry loops from sdk-integ-47. Their client retries with full jitter and low backoff (100-300ms). That floods the pool and fragments batches.
alejandro: mitigation plan: 1) short-term: bump pack_window_ms to 40 and apply tenant-level concurrency cap (limit=80) on dp-redwood-12 for sdk-integ-47. 2) medium: add token-aware scheduling so tiny requests preferentially pack into mixed batches. 3) long-term: improve autoscaler to react to pack_utilization metric, not only CPU.
megan: agree. Also add a temporary routing rule to prefer other compatible pools for that tenant while we throttle.
sre-oncall: I'll apply the short-term caps now (flipping on dry-run first), then move to enforce if metrics look good.
infra-bot: [action] apply_qos: pool=dp-redwood-12, tenant=sdk-integ-47, concurrency_cap=80, dry_run=true
megan: monitoring: watch batcher.avg_batch_size, pack_utilization, queue_depth, p95. If avg_batch_size rises >4 and pack_utilization >0.6 we can flip off dry_run.
dmitri: will run replay after dry_run to validate. If this helps, we should notify Customer A/B before making permanent changes.
support-jenny: I'll draft a customer note: explain we're throttling noisy integration and adjusting scheduler to restore throughput, ETA 30m.
dmitri: thanks team. Action items: alejandro apply tenant cap (enforce if dry_run improves), megan flip routing if needed, sre-oncall follow autoscaler logs and watch for thrash.
megan: one more note — add a short-term metric alert for pack_utilization < 0.5 in dedicated pools; we've been missing that signal.
dmitri: added to backlog, but if this runs again we should quick patch the alert.
sre-oncall: update: dry_run shows avg_batch_size -> 4.9, throughput -> 1085rps, queue_depth down 35%. Recommend enforce now.
alejandro: enforcing cap now.
infra-bot: [action] apply_qos: pool=dp-redwood-12, tenant=sdk-integ-47, concurrency_cap=80, dry_run=false
dmitri: immediate improvement visible. I'll keep monitoring for 15m then notify customers. Great work :thumbsup:
support-jenny: customer note sent.
megan: followup: schedule a plan with SDK team to add backoff jitter doc and recommend batching patterns. Also file ticket to add pack_utilization as autoscaler input.
dmitri: closing thread after 15m stable window. Thanks all!
